purpose: Restore required views and normalize historical Project context without rewriting repository-specific workflows.

normalization.historicalDraftRule: Native DraftIssue placeholders imported from document paths remain native draft items temporarily, but use Lifecycle and Context Status Historical and Status Done.
normalization.acceptedDraftRule: Accepted Issue items use Context Status Ready; Draft is reserved for proposals awaiting acceptance.
normalization.milestonePolicy: Phase children inherit the phase milestone; closed reconstructed work uses the historical milestone; unscheduled open work is labelled planning:unphased instead of receiving a fabricated deadline.

postcondition.verification: Read back from the live Project after all repository label and milestone mutations completed. Unphased open Issues intentionally have no fabricated Milestone and carry planning:unphased.
